question.value: Whether propionamide (C2H5CONH2), the largest peptide-like molecule and next member of the amide chemical family after formamide and acetamide, can be detected in the interstellar medium toward Sgr B2(N).

evidence.quote: Here we report the first tentative detection of propionamide (C 2 H 5 CONH 2 ), the largest peptide-like molecule detected in space toward Sagittarius B2(N1) at a position called N1E that is slightly offset from the continuum peak.

Whether larger molecules with a peptidelike bond could form in the ISM is still an open question. In this context, the search for more complex interstellar peptide-like molecules is a key to understanding the growth of peptides.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2016.1.00074.S.

analysis_steps.goal: Measure and model laboratory rotational spectrum of propionamide and compute partition function

method.value: Measure microwave/mm/sub-mm transitions (9-461 GHz) in three laboratories and fit rotational transitions of ground (v=0) and excited torsional states (v=1) simultaneously with methyl torsion states using the Rho axis method (RAM); calculate rotational and vibrational partition functions.

evidence.quote: The new laboratory measurements of the propionamide spectrum were carried out in the 9– 461 GHz range, providing a good opportunity to check directly for the transition frequencies of detected interstellar lines of propionamide.
Analysis of the spectra was performed using the Rho axis method (RAM) and the RAM36hf program (Ilyushin et al. 2010; Belloche et al. 2017).

key_parameters.value: K_a <= 10, J <= 50 for ground state; F fixed at 5.55 cm^-1; predictions limited to uncertainty < 0.1 MHz

evidence.quote: In the ground state (v 29, v 30 ) = (0, 0) (denoted as v=0), the rotational transitions up to K a = 10, and J up to 50 were included in the fit.
We fixed the F parameter at 5.55 cm [−1], a value that corresponds to methyl top moment of inertia I α ≈ 3.2 a.m.u. .
We limit our predictions to the transitions with calculated uncertainties lower than 0.1 MHz.

assumptions.value: Dipole moment components mu_a = 0.6359(60) D and mu_b = 3.496(30) D from Marstokk et al. (1996); vibrational modes up to 1000 cm^-1

For the calculation of the vibrational partition function, we used the excitation energies E i of all normal modes of propionamide up to 1000 cm [−1] .

fitting.value: Least-squares Hamiltonian fit in RAM36hf (26 parameters for v=0 with rms 0.035 MHz; 25 parameters for v=1 with rms 0.046 MHz)

findings_qualitative.value: Tentative detection of propionamide (C2H5CONH2) toward Sgr B2(N1E) based on 6 clean v=0 transitions, ~17 partially blended v=0 transitions, and 8 partially blended v=1 transitions.

evidence.quote: Six clean lines were detected toward Sgr B2(N1E). These lines are presented in Fig. 5 and Table 3. Approximately 17 partially blended lines were also detected.
About 40 C 2 H 5 CONH 2 v=1 lines with expected intensities above 3σ noise level were expected. Of these, eight partially blend lines were detected (Fig. 7)

findings_qualitative.value: Formamide, acetamide, and propionamide exhibit very similar spatial distributions in Sgr B2(N1), suggesting a consistent formation mechanism for the amide family.

evidence.quote: The integrated intensity maps of CH 3 CONH 2 and NH 2 CHO indicate that the amide family shows quite similar spatial distributions, implying a consistent formation mechanism in the ISM.

claims.hypothesis: Propionamide (C2H5CONH2), the next member of the amide family after formamide and acetamide, is present and detectable in the hot core region Sgr B2(N).
claims.experiment: Performed laboratory spectroscopy of propionamide across 9-461 GHz, selected an offset position Sgr B2(N1E) in archival ALMA ReMoCA 3-mm data to reduce line blending and continuum opacity, and modeled the spectrum with Weeds under LTE.
claims.result: Six clean v=0 lines, ~17 partially blended v=0 lines, and 8 partially blended v=1 lines of propionamide were detected, yielding N(C2H5CONH2) = 1.5 x 10^16 cm^-2 and an abundance of 4.3 x 10^-9 relative to H2 toward Sgr B2(N1E).
claims.finding: Propionamide is tentatively detected in space for the first time, showing that large peptide-like molecules can form and survive in massive star-forming regions.

evidence.quote: Here we report the first tentative detection of propionamide (C 2 H 5 CONH 2 ), the largest peptide-like molecule detected in space toward Sagittarius B2(N1) at a position called N1E that is slightly offset from the continuum peak.
Six clean lines were detected toward Sgr B2(N1E). These lines are presented in Fig. 5 and Table 3. Approximately 17 partially blended lines were also detected.

claims.hypothesis: Propionamide shares similar formation pathways with smaller amide molecules (formamide and acetamide).
claims.experiment: Mapped the spatial distributions and compared LTE column densities and abundances of C2H5CONH2, CH3CONH2, and NH2CHO across Sgr B2(N1) and Sgr B2(N1E).
claims.result: Integrated intensity maps show similar spatial distributions for all three amides, with [C2H5CONH2]/[CH3CONH2] ratios of 0.6 toward Sgr B2(N1E) and ~0.22 toward the main Sgr B2(N1) region.
claims.finding: The similar spatial distributions imply consistent grain-surface/ice-mantle formation mechanisms for the amide family, although the cause of the relative enhancement of propionamide at N1E remains uncertain.

evidence.quote: The integrated intensity maps of CH 3 CONH 2 and NH 2 CHO indicate that the amide family shows quite similar spatial distributions, implying a consistent formation mechanism in the ISM.
The abundance ratio [C 2 H 5 CONH 2 ]/[CH 3 CONH 2 ] toward Sgr B2(N1E) is 0.6, while toward Sgr B2(N1) is estimated to be ∼ 0.22.

why_this_data.value: IRAM 30m single-dish observations (~24'' beam) suffered from severe line blending and confusion from multiple hot cores in Sgr B2(N), requiring high angular resolution (0.6'' x 0.5'') ALMA ReMoCA archival data to isolate a less-blended offset position (Sgr B2(N1E)).

evidence.quote: That is why as the next step of our search we concentrated on ALMA archive data (see Section 3.2) which provided the HPBW for a synthesized beam of order of 0.6" × 0.5" thus allowing a search for a position in which propionamide is less contaminated by line blending from other molecules.

why_this_method.value: Continuum subtraction was performed in the image plane rather than the Fourier domain because the high density of spectral lines, varying systemic velocities, and velocity gradients make uv-plane splitting impossible.

evidence.quote: As stated in Belloche et al. (2019), because of the large number of spectral lines, their different systemic velocities, and the velocity gradients, it is impossible to split the line and continuum emission in the Fourier domain. Therefore we performed the splitting in the image plane.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Identifying propionamide using IRAM 30m single-dish data or at the Sgr B2(N1) continuum peak was rejected due to severe line blending and optically thick free-free continuum emission.

evidence.quote: For the IRAM data we have considered a number of propionamide emission lines among which two lines at 86954 MHz and 87980 MHz looked most promising. Unfortunately our pre-analysis showed that even these two lines suffer from serious line blending from other molecules.

However, the spectrum toward the continuum peak position of Sgr B2(N1) is severely affected by the optically thick free- free emission from the HII regions, and the weak COM transitions also suffer from serious line blending from other molecules (Belloche et al. 2019).

limitations_admitted.value: Detection is reported as tentative because only six transitions are completely unblended; remaining transitions are partially or heavily blended with other species.

evidence.quote: Based on the six clean lines of propionamide toward Sgr B2(N1E), which are consistent with the LTE synthetic spectrum of propionamide, we reported the tentative detection of propionamide in Sgr B2.

limitations_admitted.value: High column density and optical depth cause saturation in several NH2CHO transitions toward Sgr B2(N1) and Sgr B2(N1E).

evidence.quote: Due to the high column density and large optical depth of NH 2 CHO toward Sgr B2(N1), some lines are saturated, such as the 102065 MHz, 105465 MHz, and 106108 MHz lines.

limitations_admitted.value: Calculated transition frequency uncertainties do not include systematic errors from intervibrational interactions between methyl torsion and skeletal torsion modes, requiring restriction to K_a < 10.

evidence.quote: It should be noted that calculated uncertainties for transition frequencies can not predict possible systematic errors due to intervibrational interactions between methyl torsion and skeletal torsion modes in the molecule, since those interactions are not taken explicitly into account by our current Hamiltonian model.

referee_caveats_inferred: Excitation temperature of 150 K is assumed rather than fitted independently for propionamide and C18O.
H2 column density relies on an assumed Galactic Center C18O-to-H2 conversion factor (twice the Orion KL value) which carries substantial systematic uncertainty.
With only 6 clean lines in a line-rich hot-core spectrum, line confusion remains a major caveat, justifying the 'tentative' label.
